title: 观点：推理是可学习的基于规则的过程
summary: 本文提出推理的定义模糊导致评估效度不可验证，阻碍可信自主推理的进展。作者基于文献综合给出操作性定义，将有效且可靠的推理定位为可学习的基于规则的过程，并提供研究交流最佳实践清单。
summary_en: This position paper argues that ambiguous definitions of reasoning undermine the validity of evaluations and progress toward trustworthy autonomous reasoning. It proposes operational definitions framing reasoning as a learnable rule-based process and offers a checklist for best practices in research communication.
